_doc: Texture styles of the houses agent's rooms (gTileset_GenericBuilding, converter/gen_interior_recipes_houses.py picks one per room from Sapphire's floor metatiles). Black 2 map textures only (src = map texture set a/0/1/4). Floor size = units per repeat (Sapphire scale: 16 units = one 16-pixel tile), wall u_size = units per horizontal repeat (the texture spans the wall height once, as Black 2's m_h05_kabe does).

houses_wood._doc: Sapphire's wood-floor houses (pale wall, teal wainscot, yellow planks): wall in67kabe01 (set 348: cream with a teal band top and bottom), floor m_h06_yuka (set 347: yellow planks, 64x32 over 32 units)

houses_tatami._doc: Sapphire's Japanese rooms (plaster wall in a wood frame, green tatami, concrete entrance strip): wall m_a01_kabe (set 349: plaster over a wood panel), floor b2_yuka2 (set 282: two-tone green squares, one per tile)

houses_tile._doc: Rustboro's rooms (yellow wall, yellow checker floor): wall m_h01_07 (set 282: yellow bands), floor in01_gyuka (set 282: yellow checker, two squares per tile as Sapphire)

houses_soot._doc: Sootopolis houses (pale wall, grey/beige checker floor): wall in67kabe01 (set 348), floor in22_tile01 (set 303: light grey tiles, two per Sapphire tile)

houses_log._doc: Pacifidlog's log cabins (log walls, yellow vertical planks): wall in01_wall2 (set 282: horizontal wood planks), floor out70_yuka12 (set 278: yellow vertical planks)

houses_tree._doc: Fortree's tree houses (honey planks, a tree trunk through the room): wall dining_wall02 (set 288: wood panelling), floor m_b08_yuka (set 349: honey planks, as Littleroot)
